travel_history.complaint_details: Overbooking, resolved with a tier-status upgrade

rules.cancellation_rebooking: If a flight is cancelled by the airline, the customer is entitled to a free rebooking on the next available flight within 24 hours, or a full refund, customer's choice.
rules.delay_more_than_5_hours: Meal voucher + hotel accommodation, covering only the delayed hours (not a full night's stay)
rules.refund_processing: Full refund within 7 business days to the original payment method only.
rules.fare_difference: If a customer voluntarily chooses to rebook on a higher-fare flight, they must pay the fare difference. Agents cannot waive fare differences above ₹1,500 without supervisor approval.
rules.loyalty: Gold and Platinum customers get priority rebooking but no additional compensation beyond standard policy.

allowed: Rebook on next available flight within 24 hours at no charge for airline-caused cancellation
Issue meal vouchers and lounge access according to delay policy
Arrange hotel accommodation for the delayed-hours portion when eligible
Initiate refund request for airline-caused cancellation
Provide customer's own booking and flight status information
escalate: Threats of legal action or formal complaints
Refund to a different payment method
